experiment: K14 batch 1: common Front-prefix snapshots; is the residual conditional difference too weak, or missing content? (R1-24000 left+right -> Front-12000)
source_plans: 2026-11-07_下一阶段机制实验与创新点计划.md §3-§4, §10
2026-11-07_μd替换有效性的深层机制与实现校正.md §6 (copy capture before patch comparisons)
locked_at: before snapshot screening and before any episode of this experiment
status: development mechanism comparison (inits are development data); not a formal independent confirmation

instructions.A: pick up the book and place it in the left compartment of the caddy

snapshot.prefix: adapted model executes N (Front, its learned new task) from reset; K1 scene2 noise stream (noise_seed('scene2', init), replan noise seed + 1000003*r)
snapshot.pool: inits 20-39 (main); if fewer than 20 qualify, supplement with inits 0-19 in ascending order until 20 qualify or exhausted; supplement inits are distinct physical states, no noise repeats
snapshot.boundary_search: planning boundaries b = 30,40,...,150; earliest b satisfying all criteria is the snapshot

criteria.lifted: book z - z0 > 3 cm on each of steps b-4..b
criteria.closed_cmd: gripper command a[6] > 0 on steps b-4..b
criteria.both_contacts: at step b both finger collision geoms (finger1/finger2 collision or pad) in MuJoCo contact with a book geom
criteria.stable_relpose: book-to-eef relative position change over steps b-9..b < 0.5 cm and relative rotation change < 3 deg
criteria.pretarget: no step 1..b has the lifted book inside any of the four compartment regions, and no native predicate true

snapshot.criterion_calibration: thresholds set on dev inits 0-9 (Front prefix only, no interventions): all 10 met all criteria at b=70-90 with ~0 relative drift, first region entry at steps 123-150
snapshot.criterion_validation: retention: lifted >3 cm and both contacts on every one of the 30 native-Front steps after b; criterion counts as validated if >=90% of qualified snapshots retain; otherwise reported as not validated (episodes still run, conclusions flagged)
snapshot.integrity: snapshot rebuilt 3x from reset by replaying executed controls; sim state, controller state and camera/proprio hashes and all prefix rows must match; raw sim state + images saved in snapshots/i<init>.npz
snapshot.reporting: all candidates, qualified count, failure reasons (never lifted / never both contacts / reached region before stable / unstable); no selection on parent or intervention success; F_old recoverability recorded, failures not removed

episode.window: 60 control steps from b (6 replans x 10 Euler steps), then adapted model with the actual instruction until step 400
episode.noise: same replan noise per init across all groups

groups.A_nat: adapted native with actual instruction from b (no window) = mu_new +/- d_new
groups.C_amp: mu_old +/- d_new * (a_old/a_new); a = L2 over 50 positions x 7 real dims; the full 32-dim vector is scaled (K1-06 convention, padding follows direction source); scale capped at 10, degenerate if a_new < 1e-4*||mu_old|| -> zero difference; cap hits and degeneracy recorded
groups.D_hist: mu_old +/- d_patch, CA-7 o_proj and MLP-9 outputs patched +/- (c_old - c_new) with c from the historical aliased capture (post in-place residual state); bitwise equal to K13 'joint' (gate)
groups.D_pure: same with copy capture (pure module outputs); bitwise equal to the 11-07 capture-fixed 'joint' (gate)
groups.E_hist: D_hist difference rescaled to a_old (same cap/degenerate rule)
groups.F_old: mu_old +/- d_old = exact native R1 velocity (asserted every query)
groups.G_rand: mu_old +/- g; real 7 dims of g: per-channel random curve in the 5 lowest DCT bases over the 50 positions (d_old has median 97.9% energy there on dev probe), per-channel RMS matched to d_old, orthogonalised to d_old, rescaled to a_old; padding dims = d_old padding; seed = seed*10000 + r*100 + 2*iteration, identical for Left and Right (sign +/-)
groups.R_full: supplementary reference: native R1 from b until 400 with actual instruction (snapshot recoverability at full budget; equals batch-2 group L)
groups.N_nat: supplementary: adapted native Front from b (new-task competence on these snapshots)
groups.count: 9 window/native groups x 2 prompts x 20 snapshots = 360, + R_full 40 + N_nat 20 = 420 episodes

padding_note: dev probe: ||d_pad||/||d_real|| median 0.23 (old) and 0.43 (new); padding is fed back through the draft, so the rule above is fixed and pad ratio is logged per query

readouts.dir: paired first-arrival split per snapshot: Left first region = left AND Right first region = right (3 cm lift, 5 consecutive steps); /20
readouts.place: old-task ever native success (requested goal predicate true at any step); /40 (Left+Right)
readouts.also: Left/Right separately, first-to-front, failure types, window/overall clip rate, contacts at window end, per-query diagnostics (old-direction projection and cosine over 50x7 and 10x3, achieved norm ratio, cap hits, degeneracy, G cosine)

statistics.unit: physical snapshot (cluster); the two prompts of a snapshot are not independent
statistics.ci: paired cluster bootstrap over snapshots, 10000 resamples, seed 20261108, 95% percentile
statistics.clearly_better: X - Y >= 0.15 (point, as a fraction of the metric's denominator) AND bootstrap lower bound > 0
statistics.close: |X - Y| <= 0.10 (point estimate only; not formal equivalence)

verdicts.V1_amplitude_sufficient: C close to F on place AND neither E_hist nor E_pure clearly better than C on place
verdicts.V2_content_beyond_amplitude: E_x clearly better than C on dir or place (reported separately for x = hist, pure)
verdicts.V3_partial_content: E_x close to F on dir AND F clearly better than E_x on place
verdicts.V4_local_specificity_weak: for each x: E_x is not clearly better than both B and G on any of dir/place
verdicts.V5_snapshot_cannot_carry: F place < 20/40: other groups' negatives are not interpreted as mechanism evidence; R_full is consulted
verdicts.H_capture: D_hist vs D_pure and E_hist vs E_pure compared with the same rules (historical 18/20 is not credited to the pure version)
verdicts.G_check: G must have |cos to d_old| < 1e-3 and norm ratio within 1e-3; else G is renamed and not used as an orthogonal control

next_entry.batch2: candidate = groups among {C, E_pure, E_hist, D_pure, D_hist} clearly better than both B and G on dir or place; pick highest place (ties: dir, then order C<E_pure<E_hist<D_pure<D_hist). Run batch 2 (H-L of the plan, old mean to step 400) only if a candidate exists AND F is clearly better than it on place
next_entry.language_routing_s5: only if C clearly better than B on dir or place
next_entry.no_candidate: stop and report; no extra searching for an expected result

gates: D_hist == K13 joint bitwise, D_pure == capture-fixed joint bitwise, B_mean == K13 mean bitwise on first window input of 3 snapshots (if not bitwise: max abs diff reported, < 1e-2 required)

amendments.when: 2026-11-08, after batch-1 judgement and §5 results were seen; before any batch-2 episode
amendments.decision: user approved opening batch 2 although the locked entry rule (F clearly better than candidate on place) was not met
amendments.reason: F - C on place +0.05 (not clear) but on term +0.225 [0.125, 0.325] (clear); term is a pre-registered readout and is exactly the duration-vs-content question of plan §6
amendments.seen: batch-1 full table and comparisons; §5 table

groups.I_cand60: mu_old to 400; C_amp difference for 60 steps then d_new
groups.L: batch-1 R_full (mu_old +/- d_old == native R1, asserted bitwise per query in batch 1)

verdicts.B2_duration: J clearly better than I on term AND J clearly better than both H and K on term
verdicts.B2_content_incomplete: L clearly better than J on term
verdicts.B2_nonspecific: H or K close to J on term (|diff| <= 0.10)
verdicts.B2_both_fail: J term < 20/40 and L term < 20/40 -> recheck recoverability / budget
verdicts.aux: I vs batch-1 C (same 60-step window; after the window I keeps mu_old, C returns to the native adapted field) reported, not judged

amendments.statistics: unchanged (cluster bootstrap over the 20 snapshots, delta 0.15, close 0.10)
